issues: Activated ability cost is encoded incorrectly. Replace the nonstandard cost fields with a valid activated cost using banishFromExArea, e.g. {"cost":{"banishFromExArea":{"filter":{"identityName":"Repair Mode"},"count":2}}}, while keeping the effect that grants this follower Storm.

The upgraded mode should banish each enemy follower on the field, but it is encoded as a normal single-target banish with no count limit. Change the second choose option effect to use banishUpTo with maxCount large enough to cover all enemy followers, or another implemented all-enemy-follower banish encoding, while keeping additionalPpCost: 5.

This should be encoded as a conditional/optional play-cost modification tied to discarding 3 matching hand cards, but the current ability reference has no implemented operation for 'when playing this card, discard N matching cards: this card costs X less to play.' Add an ability/op to support optional additional play costs for playing a card, including discardFromHand of filtered cards as the cost and temporary playCostReduction as the payoff.
Keywords incorrectly include quick; the source text does not give this card Quick. Remove "quick" from keywords.

The fanfare is encoded too broadly. It should look only at the top card of your deck and add it to hand only if that specific card is a Cool card; the current searchDeckChoose could take any Cool card from the looked-at cards. Encode the top-card check so only the top card can be revealed and added.
